digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and history reclamation
propositions: The tickets-store filtered pack size exceeds the CI Verified gate limit (131,072 KiB / 128 MiB), causing stale-based changes to fail pack-size checks; proactive git repack/gc is needed to add headroom and reclaim ~1 GiB spent history

History rewrite via git fast-export with data filtering and fast-import must strip unreachable .bridge_state commits; repack alone with window=250 and depth=50 cannot reclaim the scattered historical references (measured 12.79 KB/version)

A coordinated quiet window with operator zero-session confirmation, disabled workflows, and paused timers must precede diagnostic repair (ticket 30d3), off-repo backup verification, history rewrite, repack/gc, force-with-lease publication, and deterministic first-write measurement with enrichment disabled

Identity verification must match pre/post multisets of (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) and tree/commit/merge counts must remain identical; rewritten HEAD^{tree} must equal old-tip tree and fresh clone must stay under 150 MiB

Publication requires exact force-with-lease with old-tip as ancestor check passing (old tip must not be reachable from new tip); old-tip ancestry must remain false through deterministic first post-rewrite write and re-pin review-bot vote

Rollback is an explicit second quiet window using the final off-repo bundle to restore the old tip with force-with-lease; identity.enforce_since must be reverted through Gerrit and identity-report equivalence verified before writers resume
